description:
Blacksmith Agency


 Marketing
 Full time
 Remote (USA, Canada, Latin America or South Africa)


Paid media only. SEO is a separate seat with its own strategist, so you are never split across both.

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency is an AI-first digital agency. As Performance Marketing Manager you own paid media for a book of B2B and growing-brand clients: the targeting, the budget calls, the roadmap and the narrative when the client asks why. You are the strategic voice at the table, and you make the calls.

What You Will Own


Paid media across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn and Microsoft Ads for your accounts.
Budget allocation, bidding, targeting and creative testing, and when to kill a campaign.
Conversion tracking and attribution you can trust: GA4, tag manager and platform pixels.
The 90 day and quarterly roadmap for each client, and the story behind the numbers on the call.
Account growth: retention, upsell and the long-term relationship.


What You Bring


3+ years hands-on in Google Ads and Meta: you have built, run and optimized the campaigns yourself.
A record of moving ROAS, CPA or pipeline numbers you can walk us through.
Agency experience across several clients at once.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Zenit Corp

Zenit Corp is a fast growing ecommerce group that owns and operates multiple DTC brands across different markets.

We are building a portfolio of high potential ecommerce brands with strong fundamentals, scalable systems, and ambitious long term growth plans. Our goal is to create a multi brand ecommerce group capable of reaching significant scale across different verticals.

The company is currently in a high growth stage and this creates a unique opportunity for people joining now to take ownership, grow with the company, and help shape the next stage of the group.

This is an opportunity to join early, take ownership, create impact, and help build the creative strategy function of a group with ambitious long term goals.




Role

The Creative Strategist is responsible for connecting marketing performance with creative execution. This person turns research, data, customer psychology, and business priorities into clear creative direction for paid social, landing pages, campaign concepts, and content tests.

This role is not limited to coming up with ideas. The Creative Strategist is responsible for building a structured creative process, identifying winning angles, writing strong creative briefs, analyzing what is working, and helping the team produce ads designed to perform.

This person works directly with the Head Of Marketing and marketing team, and collaborates with media buyers, designers, editors, copywriters, and creators to make sure creative output is aligned with growth objectives.

The role is expected to bring taste, structure, speed, and performance oriented thinking to a growing ecommerce group.




Creative Strategist Responsibilities




❖ Creative Strategy & Research

➢ Research customers, competitors, market trends, ad libraries, reviews, comments, and social platforms to identify strong creative opportunities.

➢ Translate customer motivations, objections, desires, and buying triggers into creative angles, hooks, messages, and offers.

➢ Build a clear understanding of each brand’s positioning and customer psychology.

➢ Stay close to what is working across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, and other relevant platforms.




❖ Ad Concepts, Hooks & Creative Briefs

➢ Develop new ad concepts, hooks, scripts, storyboards, UGC directions, landing page ideas, and campaign angles.

➢ Write clear creative briefs that explain the objective, target customer, key message, structure, examples, and success criteria.

➢ Create both quick iterations and bigger creative tests that can help unlock new performance.

➢ Maintain an organized backlog of creative tests, angles, and hypotheses for each brand.




❖ Performance Analysis & Creative Testing

➢ Analyze creative performance with the marketing team to understand what drives clicks, conversions, CPA, ROAS, retention, and scale.

➢ Identify patterns in winning and losing creatives and turn those patterns into new tests.

➢ Help define creative testing roadmaps and prioritize the ideas most likely to improve performance.

➢ Create feedback loops between performance results and future creative production.




❖ Collaboration With Creative Production

➢ Work closely with designers, editors, copywriters, media buyers, creators, and other team members to turn ideas into finished assets.

➢ Give clear, practical, and constructive feedback on creative work.

➢ Make sure creative assets are aligned with the brief, the brand, the customer insight, and the performance goal.

➢ Build repeatable frameworks, references, and standards that help the team produce better creative over time.




❖ Brand, Customer & Market Understanding

➢ Protect each brand’s positioning while still pushing for strong direct response performance.

➢ Use customer language to improve ads, landing pages, hooks, and messages.

➢ Identify new angles based on customer objections, product benefits, competitive gaps, and market shifts.

➢ Help the company build a stronger creative foundation as the group grows.




What This Role Is Not

➢ This role is not a traditional Creative Director role focused only on visual taste or brand aesthetics.

➢ This role is not a graphic designer, video editor, or content creator role, although it works closely with those functions.

➢ This role is not responsible for managing ad spend or making final media buying decisions alone.

➢ This role is not a pure social media management or community management role.

➢ This role is not responsible for defining company strategy on its own.

➢ This role is not about producing random ideas without research, structure, testing, or performance accountability.




The Creative Strategist owns creative research, angles, briefs, testing direction, performance learning, and creative feedback loops. The Head Of Marketing and marketing leadership own final business priorities, budgets, and strategic decisions.




Compensation & Benefits

➢ Compensation package of up to 25k USD including bonus, depending on experience, scope of responsibility, and performance.

➢ Opportunity to play a key role inside a rapidly growing ecommerce group.

➢ Direct exposure to company strategy, performance marketing, creative production, and brand growth.

➢ High ownership over the creation of the group’s creative strategy function.

➢ Clear path toward becoming a key creative and growth leader within a multi brand ecommerce group.

➢ Additional performance bonuses for working ads: when a concept, hook, script, or creative brief becomes a strong performing ad and materially helps improve results, the role can receive extra upside tied to that impact.




Ideal Candidate

➢ Strong creative strategy profile with the ability to connect customer insight, storytelling, and performance data.

➢ Comfortable working directly with a founder led leadership team.

➢ Able to create clear, useful, and execution oriented creative briefs.

➢ Strong understanding of paid social creative, direct response marketing, customer psychology, hooks, angles, offers, and creative testing.

➢ Comfortable analyzing ad performance and translating data into practical creative improvements.

➢ Strong written communication and copywriting ability.

➢ Highly organized, reliable, and comfortable building systems from scratch in a fast moving company.

➢ Able to collaborate with designers, editors, media buyers, copywriters, creators, and marketing operators.

➢ Has strong taste, customer empathy, and performance oriented judgment.

➢ Ambitious and comfortable operating in a fast paced, high growth environment.

➢ Previous experience in ecommerce, DTC brands, performance marketing, paid social, creative strategy, UGC, advertising, copywriting, or growth teams is highly valued.

➢ Fluent written and spoken English, C1 level mandatory.

En tu día a día te encargarás de planificar piezas de video y foto para redes sociales y otras plataformas digitales, coordinar y realizar grabaciones, así como seleccionar locaciones y recursos necesarios para cada proyecto. También editarás vídeos, optimizarás formatos para diferentes canales y colaborarás con el equipo de marketing para alinear el contenido con la estrategia de marca. Este es un puesto de tiempo completo, presencial y ubicado en Álvaro Obregón, CMX, con posibilidad de colaboración con otros equipos creativos y de comunicación de la empresa.
Requisitos
 
Aptitudes sólidas en producción de vídeo y media production, incluyendo planificación de rodajes, coordinación de recursos y gestión básica de equipo técnico.
Experiencia en video editing y new media, con capacidad para adaptar contenidos a distintos formatos y plataformas digitales (redes sociales, web, campañas de marketing).
Conocimientos y práctica en photography aplicada al marketing de contenidos, encuadre, iluminación básica y composición visual coherente con la marca.
Manejo de herramientas de edición de vídeo y foto (por ejemplo, Adobe Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, Lightroom o similares), y comprensión básica de formatos y códecs.
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo con perfiles de marketing y diseño, organización del tiempo, atención al detalle y orientación a resultados.
Formación en comunicación, marketing, producción audiovisual o áreas afines, y disposición para aprender nuevas tendencias en contenido digital y redes sociales.

description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Are you a strong writer and oral communicator who thrives at the intersection of business strategy and project management? Do you excel at transforming complex initiatives into compelling narratives that drive action?

We are seeking a Worldwide Communications Lead to join our global Sales Activation and Communications team. In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders, helping shape how key HPE priorities, programs, products, and initiatives are communicated to our worldwide sales organization and partner ecosystem.

This is an exceptional opportunity for a proven communications and project management professional who is ready to elevate their experience and impact.

You'll work as part of a highly skilled team of communications professionals and communications operations specialists to collaborate with stakehoders and senior executives across the company, and influence programs that reach thousands of sellers and partners around the world. This is more than a communications role. It is an opportunity to shape how strategic priorities come to life across HPE's global sales and partner ecosystem.

You'll gain direct exposure to senior executives, influence high-visibility business initiatives, and work on programs with worldwide reach and measurable impact.

description:
Sobre Jelou




En Jelou construimos agentes de IA que ejecutan operaciones transaccionales en canales conversacionales. Al traer pagos, verificación de identidad, flujos de crédito y firmas electrónicas directamente a WhatsApp, habilitamos a bancos, fintechs, retailers y empresas en América Latina para ejecutar transacciones generadoras de ingresos sin salir del chat, de forma segura, local y a escala.




El Rol




Como Product Partner Marketing Specialist, serás quien traduzca las capacidades de Jelou y el valor de sus alianzas estratégicas en mensajes claros, materiales comerciales y acciones conjuntas de marketing que ayudan a Sales y Partnerships a ganar clientes Enterprise. Habilitarás el go-to-market; no serás dueño de la estrategia global GTM ni del cierre comercial.




¿Qué harás?

 
Product Marketing: Desarrollar mensajes clave, propuestas de valor y diferenciadores de Jelou por solución, industria y caso de uso Enterprise, convirtiendo funcionalidades e integraciones técnicas en beneficios de negocio comprensibles para compradores y equipos comerciales.
 
Sales & Partner Enablement: Crear y actualizar presentaciones, one-pagers, casos de éxito, fichas de producto, argumentarios y kits comerciales para Sales, Partnerships y resellers, manteniendo una narrativa consistente.
 
Partner Marketing: Coordinar con Partnerships planes de co-marketing y lanzamientos conjuntos con aliados de ecosistema y resellers; definir briefs, mensajes y kits de campaña, y dar seguimiento a su ejecución y resultados.
 
Soporte a GTM: Apoyar lanzamientos y campañas Enterprise con mensajes, materiales y briefs alineados a las prioridades definidas por CMO, Product, Sales y Partnerships.




Responsabilidades clave

 
Mantener materiales de posicionamiento y apoyar la comunicación de nuevos productos o funcionalidades.
 
Coordinar con Brand, Demand Generation y Field Marketing la ejecución de las iniciativas con partners.
 
Coordinar la consistencia del mensaje entre las diferentes áreas, sin asumir la propiedad del calendario o presupuesto global de marketing.
 
Definir el mensaje y habilitar los materiales, mientras Partnerships mantiene la relación comercial, Brand produce los activos, Demand Generation opera campañas, Field ejecuta eventos y RevOps/Analytics mide la contribución.




Buscamos a alguien con

 
4–6+ años en Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Sales Enablement o marketing B2B SaaS, idealmente en tecnología compleja.
 
Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Product, Sales y Partnerships, coordinando entregables sin autoridad jerárquica.
 
Conocimiento de Enterprise GTM, campañas de co-marketing y ecosistemas de partners, con ejemplos de ejecución.
 
Capacidad de explicar cómo prioriza entregables y qué decisiones tomó con foco en resultados de negocio.
 
Inglés profesional.




Suma puntos si tienes

 
Materiales reales donde hayas traducido una integración o funcionalidad técnica en un beneficio de negocio para un comprador Enterprise.
 
Un kit, one-pager o argumentario que Sales, Partnerships o resellers realmente hayan usado.
 
Una campaña o lanzamiento de co-marketing con un partner y el número que la representa.
 
Un ejemplo de alineación de 3 o más áreas sin ser dueño de ninguna.
 
Un ejemplo de qué dejaste fuera en un lanzamiento y por qué.

Disponibilidad, calidad y utilización de materiales de ventas y de partners 
 
Lanzamientos y campañas conjuntas habilitadas en tiempo y con mensajes consistentes 
 
Número de partners habilitados y campañas de co-marketing ejecutadas 
 
Contribución al pipeline sourced/influenced (KPI compartido con Partnerships, Demand Generation y RevOps)

Postúlate y únete a Jelou para liderar la narrativa y las alianzas que aceleren la adopción de agentes de IA transaccionales en las empresas más grandes de LATAM. Valoramos un proceso de selección inclusivo y fomentamos candidaturas de todes les cuales se identifiquen con el rol.

title: Campaign Manager — Mexico City
description:
Influur

is redefining how advertising works — through creators, data, and AI. Our mission is to make influencer marketing as measurable, predictable, and scalable as paid ads — and we're building the tech that powers it. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by global brands, we're scaling fast across music and culture.

We’re looking for a

Campaign Manager

to own the end-to-end execution of influencer campaigns, acting as the bridge between sellers, influencers, and brands. This role is perfect for someone with excellent project management skills, a deep understanding of creator dynamics, and the ability to juggle multiple campaigns without compromising quality or timelines.

If you’re passionate about execution, thrive in fast-paced environments, and love making things happen — this one’s for you.

Your Skillset

Own the end-to-end execution of campaigns after the sale — from kickoff to final report.

Coordinate cross-functional communication with sellers, retention managers, and influencers.

Manage up to 30 influencer campaigns simultaneously.

Take full ownership of: Timeline coordination, Influencer slating, Draft review and verification, Ensuring full completion of deliverables, Acting as the voice of the influencer throughout the process.

Deliver white-glove service to clients, ensuring alignment with brand tone, voice, and strategy.

Stay updated with platform trends, creator shifts, and what's going viral.

Negotiate influencer rates and understand estimated budgets.

Track and optimize campaign budgets.

Monitor deliverables and ensure high-quality content that meets brand guidelines and campaign goals.

Proactively flag and resolve issues, escalating when necessary and proposing solutions.

Stay organized and manage multiple timelines, creators, and deliverables in parallel.

Gather all required inputs (e.g., shipping addresses, product info, payment details).

Collaborate with Data Ops for post-campaign performance reporting.

You’re the Type Who

Thrives in fast-moving environments and gets things done under pressure.

Brings structure, clarity, and ownership to every campaign.

Understands the nuances of creator and client communication.

Is obsessed with details, timelines, and quality.

Brings a proactive, problem-solving mindset to daily challenges.

Is bilingual (English & Spanish) and familiar with U.S. and LatAm creator markets.

What we offer

Competitive equity in a venture-backed company.

Opportunities to grow fast and develop.

Remote work.

Direct connection to our exclusive community of influencers — from global stars to the next big thing.

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
skills: Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working

Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people

Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing

Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery

Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt

You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search
You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have

You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it

You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too
"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed
You want to be told what to do this week
You need a ticketing system to know what matters
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question
description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

El/La Especialista de Servicio al Cliente y Soporte Local será responsable de proporcionar atención especializada, personalizada y proactiva a Clientes, Market Partners y Líderes de MONAT México, asegurando una experiencia de servicio excepcional y una gestión eficiente de las necesidades específicas del mercado.




Esta posición actuará como enlace estratégico y operativo entre el mercado mexicano y los equipos internos de MONAT, con especial enfoque en la gestión de escalaciones, resolución de incidencias, seguimiento de solicitudes operativas y fortalecimiento de las relaciones con los Líderes.




Asimismo, será responsable de mantener una comunicación proactiva con Líderes seleccionados, identificar oportunidades de mejora, anticipar posibles situaciones de servicio y facilitar soluciones mediante una coordinación efectiva con los departamentos correspondientes.




El puesto también proporcionará soporte presencial en las oficinas de MONAT México, así como durante eventos, lanzamientos y otras iniciativas locales. 




Responsabilidades Principales




1. Servicio al Cliente y Gestión de Escalaciones

Actuar como punto de contacto local para situaciones de Customer Care que requieran atención especializada, conocimiento del mercado mexicano o coordinación presencial.

Coordinar con los equipos internos correspondientes para facilitar soluciones oportunas y efectivas.
Mantener comunicación constante con las partes involucradas, proporcionando actualizaciones claras sobre el estatus y resolución de los casos.
Identificar causas raíz, tendencias y problemas recurrentes, proponiendo acciones preventivas y oportunidades de mejora.
Escalar oportunamente situaciones críticas, de alto impacto o riesgo al liderazgo correspondiente.
Brindar orientación y capacitación proactiva, individual o grupal, presencial o virtual, cuando se identifiquen oportunidades para fortalecer el conocimiento de los procesos y prevenir incidencias recurrentes.




2. Relacionamiento y Comunicación Proactiva con Líderes

Establecer y mantener relaciones profesionales de confianza con Líderes seleccionados del mercado mexicano.
Realizar reuniones de seguimiento (check-ins) quincenales o mensuales, de acuerdo con las prioridades establecidas por el negocio.
Identificar, escuchar y documentar inquietudes, necesidades, comentarios y oportunidades de mejora.
Coordinar el seguimiento de los compromisos adquiridos y asegurar una comunicación oportuna sobre su avance.
Compartir información relevante sobre procesos, actualizaciones operativas e iniciativas que puedan impactar al mercado.
Proporcionar al liderazgo de Customer Care visibilidad sobre tendencias, necesidades emergentes y oportunidades para fortalecer la experiencia del mercado.

3. Coordinación y Soporte Operativo del Mercado

Coordinar y dar seguimiento a solicitudes operativas locales relacionadas con Customer Care y la experiencia del mercado mexicano.
Apoyar la coordinación y el seguimiento de activaciones, desactivaciones y actualizaciones de SKUs, en colaboración con los departamentos responsables.
Facilitar la resolución de incidencias relacionadas con pedidos y entregas, incluyendo la coordinación directa con DHL, el almacén local y los equipos internos correspondientes.

Identificar oportunidades para simplificar procesos, reducir incidencias recurrentes y mejorar la eficiencia operativa.

4. Soporte en Eventos, Lanzamientos e Iniciativas Locales

Proponer iniciativas orientadas a mejorar la experiencia del Cliente y Market Partner, fortalecer la comunicación y prevenir problemas recurrentes.

Requisitos

Orquestas el ciclo completo — handoff, implementación, go-live, estabilización y expansión — sin autoridad formal sobre Deployment, Producto o Soporte, consiguiendo que entreguen a través de relación e influencia, no de jerarquía.

Ejecutar business reviews recurrentes y ser dueño del proceso de renovación de punta a punta

description:
FARO INSIGHT Exists to Turn Reality into Understanding

We believe the world is shaped by decisions and those decisions only hold up when they’re grounded in objective truth. Our solutions capture buildings, sites and scenes exactly as they are and transform that data into insight teams can use to plan, verify, investigate and act with confidence.

Across Architecture, Engineering & Construction (AECO), Geospatial and Public Safety, we support professionals who establish truth, verify progress, investigate events and protect people & places. From surveyors defining the foundations of a project, to architects and builders coordinating complex infrastructure, to public safety professionals documenting critical incidents to deliver justice to communities. Our solutions underpin accountability and inspire trust in every decision.

At FARO INSIGHT, we admire individuals who wish to shape the future with us. Who believe leadership starts with responsibility. Who believe great innovation serves real-world outcomes. And who believe in long-term impact, over short-term noise. Here, you will be part of a team that puts those beliefs into action, creating work that makes a meaningful difference.

Insight You Can Build On.

To support our growth across LATAM we are looking for a Renewal Specialist based in Mexico.

The Renewal Specialist is responsible for driving customer retention, recurring revenue growth, and customer satisfaction through the proactive management of FARO service, software maintenance, subscription, and support agreement renewals. This role is also responsible for actively pursuing accessories, training, and aftermarket sales opportunities. The role owns the end-to-end renewal lifecycle within assigned territories and partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Support, Finance, and Operations teams to ensure customers continue to realize value from their FARO solutions.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, results-oriented, highly organized, and capable of managing a high-volume renewal portfolio while consistently achieving quarterly revenue targets.

Key Responsibilities

Renewal Lifecycle Management


Own and manage the complete renewal process for assigned customer accounts and territories.
Proactively identify upcoming renewals and execute structured customer outreach campaigns to maximize on-time renewal rates.
Prepare and deliver renewal quotations for service plans, software maintenance, subscriptions, training, accessories, and other eligible aftermarket offerings.
Manage all renewal-related activities including quote generation, customer follow-up, purchase order collection, DocuSign execution, order processing, and fulfillment coordination.
Maintain a healthy renewal pipeline and ensure opportunities progress according to established timelines and service levels.


Revenue Attainment & Forecasting

About The Client

A fast-growing US healthcare technology company offering direct-to-consumer and B2B laboratory testing is looking for an Operations Coordinator to deliver highly responsive customer support, document scalable processes, and build AI-powered workflows that reduce manual work.

The company runs an out-of-pocket testing model with no insurance pre-authorizations and has scaled its customer base significantly in recent months, with four client implementations running in parallel. Its support operation already deflects about 70% of cases through AI, and the team is pushing that number higher.

About The Role

Day-to-day, you will work in Slack, Intercom, and Notion, splitting your time across customer support (about 40%), process documentation (30%), AI automation (25%), and B2B partner operations (5%). This is a Wednesday to Sunday role, so you will keep operations moving through the weekend when the rest of the team is offline. Success means fast and consistent response times, documentation others can follow without help, and a measurable increase in case deflection and automation rates within your first 90 days.

Core Responsibilities

Customer Support & Communication

Respond to B2C lab testing customer inquiries in Intercom and Slack within set response-time targets

Own Saturday and Sunday support coverage so no customer issue waits until Monday

Resolve testing, scheduling, and results-related issues, and escalate edge cases with full context

Handle patient information in line with HIPAA requirements (training provided)

Process Creation & Documentation

Document existing customer and partner workflows as step-by-step SOPs in Notion

Build new processes to support multiple concurrent client implementations

Keep the knowledge base current as products, partners, and policies change

AI Automation & Workflow Optimization

Build and refine Intercom Fin workflows to raise case deflection above the current 70%

Increase the support automation rate beyond the current 60%

Identify manual tasks outside Intercom and build AI-powered workflows to remove them

Connect automations across Intercom, Slack, and Notion

B2B Partner Operations

Coordinate daily lab partner logistics during the 11:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST partner window

Track partner requests and implementation tasks through to completion

Log all partner communication so handoffs stay clean

Requirements

Must-Have

2+ years in customer support operations, customer operations, or operations coordination, with at least 1 year at a startup or scale-up

Direct customer-facing support experience handling B2C or B2B inquiries through chat, email, or ticketing channels

Hands-on Intercom experience (inbox, help center, macros, or workflows)

Built at least one automated support or operations workflow (Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI, Zapier, Make, or equivalent) with a measurable result such as case deflection rate, automation rate, or hours saved

Created SOPs, process documentation, or knowledge base articles from scratch in Notion or an equivalent wiki, with daily Slack use

Available 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST, Wednesday – Sunday, including full Saturday and Sunday shifts

C1+ English (CEFR) for direct communication with US customers and lab partners

Nice-to-Have

Intercom Fin AI Agent configuration, including agentic procedures or multi-step workflows

Healthcare, laboratory testing, telehealth, or digital health operations experience

Working knowledge of HIPAA-compliant handling of patient data

Experience supporting both B2C customers and B2B partners in the same role, including partner logistics or implementation coordination

Fully remote—work from anywhere

Lead complex, cross-functional client initiatives as project manager and primary liaison among clients and internal partners, including product, investments, marketing, legal and compliance, operations, technology and sales support.

Travel within Mexico, as required, to meet existing and prospective clients and support industry and client events.

Experience distributing investment products and acting as a trusted partner to advisory and investment teams.
Demonstrated knowledge of financial markets, portfolio construction and the economic outlook, with the ability to connect market views to client needs and commercial opportunities.
Proven ability to build and develop senior client relationships and successfully sell investment products and solutions.
Demonstrated project management experience, including coordinating cross-functional teams, managing multiple priorities, monitoring milestones and risks, and driving initiatives to timely completion.
Experience preparing and delivering high-impact presentations, training sessions and public-speaking engagements for senior, technical and non-technical audiences.

Practical experience using artificial intelligence tools to improve productivity, research, communication and client preparation, with sound judgment regarding data privacy, accuracy, intellectual property and compliance.
Strong collaboration skills, a hands-on mindset and the ability to mobilize BlackRock’s resources on behalf of clients.

Strong commercial acumen, consultative sales capability and analytical skills, with a record of converting client needs into actionable opportunities.
Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams and OneNote, and confidence adopting approved AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot.
Strong project management and execution skills, including work planning, stakeholder management, risk identification, prioritization and follow-through across parallel workstreams.

Highly effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex investment topics clearly and to present confidently in one-on-one meetings, executive forums, large groups and conferences.
Ability to position and combine the benefits of active strategies, index solutions, ETFs, model portfolios and alternative investments in the context of client portfolios.
High standards of judgment, attention to detail and integrity, including appropriate handling of confidential information and adherence to applicable legal, regulatory and compliance requirements.
A postgraduate degree in business, finance or a related field is preferred. Relevant industry credentials are a plus.
description:
About This Role

Business Unit Overview: 

The Latin America group serves institutional and wealth clients throughout the region, including corporate, public and industry pension plans, insurance companies, third-party mutual funds, endowments, foundations, charities, corporations, official institutions, banks, registered investment advisors, family offices and other financial intermediaries.

Professionals across the team work together to deliver asset management, risk management and advisory services aligned with clients’ needs. Operating through a unified global client platform, the Wealth business is accountable for client relationships and the distribution of products and services, supported by centralized functions that promote consistency and scale.

BlackRock’s Mexico Wealth Team, part of the Latin America business, is one of the region’s most dynamic businesses. By focusing on the distribution of BlackRock products through private banks, independent advisors and family offices, the team has helped strengthen BlackRock’s position as a leading provider of investment solutions in Mexico.

The team leads the distribution of BlackRock products and services across the wealth segment in Mexico. A core part of the business is the distribution and client coverage of a broad suite of mutual funds domiciled in the Mexican market, offering solutions for different end-investor segments through local distributors.

Job Purpose/Background

Responsible for business development and strategic relationship management across Mexico’s wealth market, including private banks, independent advisors and family offices.

The role requires strong commercial judgment, a solid understanding of the Mexican mutual fund industry, disciplined project management and the ability to translate investment capabilities into relevant client solutions.

The Vice President will deliver BlackRock’s asset management capabilities to end investors through financial intermediaries and will position the firm’s full range of investment solutions, including money market funds, open-end funds, ETFs, managed portfolios and alternative investments. The successful candidate will also lead cross-functional initiatives, use digital and artificial intelligence tools responsibly to improve productivity and client engagement, and represent BlackRock effectively in client meetings, training sessions, conferences and other public forums.

Responsibilities


Drive sales of BlackRock products and services by developing deep relationships with investment, commercial strategy and advisory teams at key distribution partners. 
Build and maintain strategic relationships with private banks, independent advisors, family offices and other wealth intermediaries across Mexico. 
Develop a strong understanding of each client’s business model, priorities, product architecture, sales channels and end-investor needs, and translate those insights into actionable commercial plans. 
Apply knowledge of the Mexican mutual fund industry, including local fund structures, distributors, operating companies, regulation, competitive dynamics and market trends, to identify opportunities and anticipate client needs. 
Position and differentiate BlackRock’s active, index, ETF, model portfolio, cash management and alternative investment capabilities against relevant competitors. 
Lead complex, cross-functional client initiatives as project manager and primary liaison among clients and internal partners, including product, investments, marketing, legal and compliance, operations, technology and sales support. 
Create and manage clear project plans with defined objectives, workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks and decision points, and maintain consistent stakeholder communication through completion. 
Develop and negotiate commercial agreements that support sustainable growth across BlackRock’s product and services suite. 
Identify high-potential products, services, clients and segments, and develop action plans to address underpenetrated or underperforming opportunities. 
Monitor client and product performance to refine sales strategies, prioritize resources and provide transparent reporting on pipeline, progress and outcomes. 
Identify and address training, content and service gaps, working with relevant teams to improve the experience of advisors and end investors. 
Design and deliver compelling presentations for senior executives, advisors, clients and large audiences, including conferences, investment forums and training sessions. 
Use approved artificial intelligence and digital productivity tools, such as Microsoft Copilot and internal platforms, to support research, meeting preparation, content development, data synthesis and workflow efficiency, while complying with information security, confidentiality and compliance requirements. 
Maintain accurate and current activity, relationship and opportunity data in the relevant CRM system, including client profiles, organizational structures, key contacts, sales opportunities and priorities. 
Travel within Mexico, as required, to meet existing and prospective clients and support industry and client events. 


Development Opportunity


This role is positioned to benefit from the continued growth of Mexico’s wealth segment. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to help shape the team’s structure and ways of working while making a meaningful contribution to the future success of the Mexico Wealth business. 
An opportunity to join a market leader in Mexico’s growing mutual fund industry. Exposure to the broader BlackRock organization also provides the right candidate with a range of potential career paths. 
An opportunity to develop demand for BlackRock’s capabilities across the region and help shape a high-quality, strategically aligned client base. 


Knowledge And Experience


High degree of cultural awareness and the ability to work effectively across local, regional and global teams. 
Fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken, is required. 
Strong understanding of Mexico’s wealth and retail investment market, including private banks, financial advisors, family offices, local distributors and relevant sales channels. 
Solid knowledge of the Mexican mutual fund industry, including locally domiciled investment funds, fund operating companies, distribution arrangements, product structures, regulation, fees, share classes, competitive positioning and key industry trends. 
Experience distributing investment products and acting as a trusted partner to advisory and investment teams. 
Demonstrated knowledge of financial markets, portfolio construction and the economic outlook, with the ability to connect market views to client needs and commercial opportunities. 
Proven ability to build and develop senior client relationships and successfully sell investment products and solutions. 
Demonstrated project management experience, including coordinating cross-functional teams, managing multiple priorities, monitoring milestones and risks, and driving initiatives to timely completion. 
Experience preparing and delivering high-impact presentations, training sessions and public-speaking engagements for senior, technical and non-technical audiences. 
Practical experience using artificial intelligence tools to improve productivity, research, communication and client preparation, with sound judgment regarding data privacy, accuracy, intellectual property and compliance. 
Strong collaboration skills, a hands-on mindset and the ability to mobilize BlackRock’s resources on behalf of clients. 
A proactive, highly organized team player who can lead improvements in execution, operating discipline and change management. 


Skills And Qualifications


3-5 years of relevant experience as an investment, wealth management or financial services professional is preferred. 
Strong commercial acumen, consultative sales capability and analytical skills, with a record of converting client needs into actionable opportunities. 
Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams and OneNote, and confidence adopting approved AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot. 
Strong project management and execution skills, including work planning, stakeholder management, risk identification, prioritization and follow-through across parallel workstreams. 
Highly effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex investment topics clearly and to present confidently in one-on-one meetings, executive forums, large groups and conferences. 
Ability to position and combine the benefits of active strategies, index solutions, ETFs, model portfolios and alternative investments in the context of client portfolios. 
High standards of judgment, attention to detail and integrity, including appropriate handling of confidential information and adherence to applicable legal, regulatory and compliance requirements. 
A postgraduate degree in business, finance or a related field is preferred. Relevant industry credentials are a plus. 


Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

BlackRock will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the requirements of the law, including any applicable fair chance law.

description:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet The Team 

At Fever, our Business Development team is both the face of Fever in the market and the voice of the market within Fever. Sitting at the core of our platform, they connect the world’s best experiences with the largest audiences, helping the live entertainment industry grow and evolve.

Our team builds trusted, long-term partnerships with leading brands across the ecosystem. We work closely with creators, producers, agencies, and cultural leaders to help them make data-driven decisions, expand their portfolios, and scale internationally. In doing so, we play a key role in shaping the future of the entertainment landscape.

This role goes far beyond relationship management. It requires strong strategic thinking and problem-solving across a wide range of topics, from marketing and pricing to operations and financing. The most successful team members take full ownership of their partners’ success, acting as true partners and advisors at every stage of growth.

Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Business Development works hand-in-hand with Marketing, Category Management, Partner Support, Operations, Tech, Product, and Finance to ensure every experience on our platform reaches its full potential.

Our team is diverse, entrepreneurial, and dynamic, bringing together talent from consulting, banking, big tech, and startups. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where creativity meets data, and ambition meets execution.

Join us if you’re passionate about discovering world-class experiences, building meaningful partnerships, and scaling some of the most exciting concepts across the globe.

The Role

In this role, you will drive Fever’s expansion across Mexico's entertainment industry by building and nurturing deep commercial relationships with top producers, creators, venues, and key stakeholders. You will develop and execute an innovative growth strategy to scale our market presence, expertly managing commercial strategies to ensure mutual value creation and build sustainable, long-term partnerships with event organizers. By collaborating closely with cross-functional teams both in Mexico and internationally, you will successfully balance a growing client base while serving as our in-house expert on the coolest trends and newest experiences in the entertainment landscape.

What You'll Do


Develop and deliver a growth strategy for the market, with an innovative and effective approach to scaling Fever's presence in the region
Expertly manage commercial strategy with large partners ensuring value creation for both parties, and a sustainable strategic partnership between Fever and event organisers
Create and cultivate deep business relationships with the biggest producers, creators, venues and key stakeholders in the entertainment industry
Evidence strong organizational skills to effectively balance and grow a large base of clients 
Collaborate closely with cross functional stakeholders to successfully deliver on partner growth across Mexico and internationally
Keep up to date with everything cool that’s happening in the entertainment; think of yourself as the expert for new and trending experiences


Who You Are

At least 5+ years of top tier consulting or top tech equivalent experience, plus another 4+ years of relevant experience.

Self-starter mentality with an ability to work in a demanding, dynamic start-up environment

Why You'll Love It Here

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Product Support Operations (PSO) team plays a key role in efficiently solving our users’ issues. As part of our PSO team, you will be a critical driver in delivering exceptional user experiences. This role goes beyond basic troubleshooting—it's about using your technical expertise, analytical mindset, and project management skills to strategically improve our support systems, processes, and product quality. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible.

Our Quality team sits at the heart of that mission. We are responsible for defining and upholding the standards that shape every user interaction across our support verticals. We believe that quality is not just a score — it is a reflection of the care and expertise we bring to every user, every time.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will own quality outcomes at your site, leading a team of approximately 6 Quality Analysts spanning multiple support verticals. Your team plays a critical role in upholding the quality standards that underpin the experience we deliver to Stripe's users and you will be the person who drives that standard forward at your site.

Beyond your team, you will serve as a key voice in the evolution of our quality program and a strategic partner to vertical leads. To be a great fit, you will have a quality first mindset, the ability to translate data into action, a track record of coaching others to grow, and the cross functional credibility to influence without authority across a multi vertical environment.

Responsibilities


Own UIQ quality scores across all verticals at your site, driving teams to meet and sustain a minimum 90% quality score
Serve as the final escalation layer for Disputes at your site, ensuring fair, consistent, and well reasoned outcomes
Review quality trends for each vertical at your site, identifying patterns and surfacing risks before they become issues
Complete case work to stay close to the day to day realities of the verticals’ subject matter and maintain subject matter familiarity
Participate in calibration sessions across verticals to drive alignment and consistency in scoring
Help lead rubric updates and contribute to the continuous evolution of our quality framework
Drive projects at the quality program level, contributing to broader initiatives that improve how quality is measured and managed across PSO
Deliver high-level quality reporting for all verticals at your site, providing leadership with a clear and actionable view of performance
Provide insights and recommendations back to vertical leads, translating quality data into concrete operational guidance
Manage and develop a team of ~6 Quality Analysts representing verticals including Payments, Revenue Suite, Account & Connect, Money Management, Enterprise, and Community Ops
Set clear goals and expectations for individual and team performance
Coach and mentor individuals through structured career development conversations
Provide continuous performance feedback and facilitate formal performance reviews
Foster a culture of continuous improvement and psychological safety within the team
Drive and own initiatives that make the team an engaging and motivating place to work
Support recruitment and hiring initiatives as the team evolves



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Experience coaching or leading teams, with a demonstrated ability to manage and develop individual performance
Prior experience in a QA or quality assurance capacity within a product support or customer service organisation
Experience mentoring others and delivering constructive, growth-oriented feedback
Proven subject matter expertise in product support or customer service operations
Ability to work cross-functionally across multiple teams or verticals to drive results and foster partnership
Strong analytical skills — able to identify trends in quality data and translate them into clear, actionable insights
Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills
Exemplary planning and time management skills, balancing people leadership, reporting, and program-level responsibilities



Preferred Qualifications


Experience delivering quality or business performance reporting to leadership
Experience participating in or facilitating calibration sessions
Experience contributing to rubric development or quality framework design
Experience with new process launches and continuous improvement initiatives



Stripe is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

description:
About Influur

Influur is reimagining how advertising works through creators, data, and AI. Our mission is to make influencer marketing as measurable, predictable, and scalable as paid media, and we’re building the tech that makes it possible.

Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by global brands, we’re scaling fast across music, culture, and entertainment.

We’re looking for a

List Builder

who’s excited to discover the right creators for every campaign, turning brand briefs into highly relevant, strategic creator lists. You’ll combine research, data, cultural awareness, and strong judgment to identify creators who truly fit each brand, audience, and campaign objective.

Your Skillset

Must-haves

1+ years of experience

in influencer marketing, creator marketing, talent sourcing, social media, digital marketing, or a similar role.

Hands-on experience

researching, sourcing, and evaluating creators

across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Strong understanding of

creator and brand fit , including audience demographics, engagement, content style, market relevance, and brand alignment.

Ability to translate a

campaign or client brief into clear creator selection criteria

and build targeted lists accordingly.

Strong knowledge of

social media trends, creators, digital culture, and emerging communities .

Ability to work with

high volumes of creator profiles and multiple briefs simultaneously

while maintaining accuracy and quality.

Strong research skills and attention to detail, with the ability to go beyond obvious or repetitive creator choices.

Comfortable working with

data and performance metrics

to support creator recommendations.

Strong organizational skills and ability to work quickly in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Professional proficiency in

English and Spanish .

Nice-to-haves

Experience working at an

influencer marketing agency, creator platform, talent agency, or fast-growing startup .

Experience sourcing creators for campaigns in

music, beauty, entertainment, CPG, or lifestyle .

Familiarity with influencer marketing platforms, social listening tools, or creator discovery tools.

Experience using

AI tools to accelerate creator research, analyze profiles, identify trends, or improve sourcing workflows .

Experience supporting campaigns across multiple markets, particularly the

US and LATAM .

You’re The Type Who

Has an eye for creators.

You can look at a brief and quickly understand what kind of creator makes sense, beyond follower count alone.

Is naturally curious.

You enjoy going down the rabbit hole of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, trends, communities, and emerging creators to find profiles others might miss.

Moves fast without sacrificing quality.

You understand that creator marketing moves quickly and can deliver strong lists under tight timelines.

Thinks beyond the obvious.

You don’t rely on the same creators everyone already knows. You’re resourceful and creative in how you search.

Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

You can manage hundreds of profiles, multiple briefs, and changing requirements without losing track of the details.

Takes ownership.

If a list isn’t strong enough, you don’t wait for someone to tell you. You keep searching, refining, and improving it.

Is AI-curious.

You’re excited to experiment with AI and automation to research faster, identify better matches, and improve the way creator sourcing gets done.

Thrives in startup environments.

You’re comfortable with speed, ambiguity, changing priorities, and figuring things out as you go.

description:
About the Role

Lumenalta is a technology firm of more than 500 specialists who build data, AI, and software solutions for enterprise clients. Our marketing team is growing its video program, and we're hiring a Junior Video Editor to turn raw footage into polished clips that put our people and our work in front of buyers.




You'll edit executive interviews, client stories, product demos, and social video, working closely with our Design Lead and the wider marketing team. It's an entry-level role, ideal for a recent graduate who wants to build a professional portfolio on a steady flow of real projects, with hands-on coaching from our Design Lead.




What You'll Do

Edit executive and expert interviews. Cut longer recorded conversations into 3–4 short clips each for LinkedIn, the website, and media pitching, about two interviews a month.
Help produce the executive video series. Edit brand and point-of-view videos from multi-camera footage, from rough cut to final approval.
Build videos from stock and animation. Assemble voiceover-led videos, such as partner introductions, using licensed stock footage and simple motion graphics.
Edit product and solution demos. Turn screen recordings into clear business and technical demo videos for sales.
Create social and event content. Produce cutdowns, captions, and recaps, formatted for each channel's aspect ratio and length.
Keep everything on brand. Apply Lumenalta's visual identity, typography, lower thirds, and caption styles consistently.
Manage the video library. Organize footage, project files, music licenses, and final exports so the team can find and reuse them.
Work from feedback. Turn around revisions quickly and track versions through review with Mariano and the people on camera.




What You'll Bring

A recent degree in film, video production, communications, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience from internships, student media, freelance, or personal projects.
A portfolio or reel of class, internship, or personal work, ideally including interviews or short-form social video.
Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro.
A good ear for pacing and story: you can find the strongest 30 seconds in a 30-minute interview.
Comfort with AI-assisted editing tools for transcription, rough cuts, and captions.
Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and turn around revisions quickly, plus clear written communication and good organization.




Nice to Have

Some experience with After Effects or another motion graphics tool.
Familiarity with Figma or Canva for thumbnails and simple graphics.
Basic audio cleanup and color correction.
Interest in technology, or an internship in marketing or agency video.

How We Work

Fully remote, with at least a 6-hour overlap with US Eastern time.
Reports to Mariano Xerez, Design Lead, and works day to day with the marketing team, including content, digital PR, and design.
Coaching from day one: weekly rough-cut reviews with Mariano and a steady project flow planned on a shared content calendar.




Desired Qualities

Core tools and skills

Adobe Premiere Pro. Our editing software of choice. Applicants must be able to create projects, import content via XML, edit sequences, color correct, audio correct, generate transcript, use effects and MOGRT and export media files for multiple formats.
Organizational skills. Applicants need to be organized, track projects using a Slack ticketing system, Google Sheets and Frame.io. They will be onboarded in the company best practices for all those tools.
Footage sourcing. Applicants must be well versed in finding and sourcing stock footage, and adapting it to the needs of a project. They will get access to the stock libraries we use and guidance on stock quality and voice.
Communication. Our team is fully remote and international. Applicants must be able to communicate creative and technical ideas in English and understand scripts, briefings, narrative texts and everyday instructions and communications.




Desirable tools and skills

AI-assisted editing. Applicants with experience using Claude to assist in their editing will be preferred.
Adobe After Effects. Applicants with experience in basic Motion Design (masking, basic animation, rotoscoping, type motion) will be preferred.
Adobe Audition. Applicants with experience in sound design, sound editing and refinement will be preferred.
Figma. Applicants with experience producing thumbnails using Figma and its associated AI capabilities will be preferred.




Location

This is a fully remote position open to candidates based anywhere in the Americas (North, Central, and South America); candidates must be able to work with full overlap with U.S. business hours to ensure effective collaboration with client and team schedules.

Applications will be accepted until November 22nd, 2026. Candidates can expect feedback by November 30th, 2026.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Associate Programmatic who will:


Interact effectively with regional teams (Europe, U.S., Asia) and be a strong communicator.

Bachelor’s degree.

Have 1.5-2 years of implementing and optimizing programmatic campaigns in DV360, The Trade Desk, MediaMath, Xandr and other DSPs. 
Advanced Excel skills.  
Strong analytical and numerical skills. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

For Colombia

This position is in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed within Colombian territory. Only candidates residing in Colombia with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work contracts do not allow employment or relocation abroad.

Inflection Club is a private co-investment community for accredited investors, operators, and family offices who want direct access to pre-IPO deals in the companies shaping the future. Our thesis is simple: the biggest returns of the next decade will come from companies built on the cost curves of artificial intelligence, robotics, longevity, and next-generation infrastructure. We help our members invest in those companies 12 to 18 months before they go public, deal-by-deal, with full discretion.

We are not a fund. We are a club. No blind pools, no lock-ups, no marketing dressed up as deal flow. Every member chooses what they back, and we handle everything else - sourcing, diligence, SPV formation, legal, reporting, and the live community that makes the whole thing run.

What You Will Do:

The CRM Coordinator is the operational backbone of our member and prospect pipeline. You will own the integrity and performance of our CRM - ensuring every contact, deal stage, and communication touchpoint is accurate, timed, and purposeful.

This is not a data-entry role. We need someone who understands why the data matters, takes ownership of process breakdowns before anyone else notices them, and continuously improves how we track and engage our community. Requirements
